reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the box, and the fact that the Bisglycinate has no oxide. Citrate wrecks my stomach, so I skip the Complex, but a named lab report I can open is the only proof I would accept from a supplement, so I would try one box.
objection: Most supplements are marketing, and a QR code does not prove anything until I actually open it and see a real report with this batch number. $29.99 is a lot to risk on a brand I saw in one creator video.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the QR and finding a real, named ISO 17025 lab report for that batch with the magnesium content matching the label.
